answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks via stake bonds with exponential decay. Each identity posts a bond, and the bond's weight decays over time, forcing attackers to re-stake continuously to maintain influence. Agent posts bond, network mints weighted identity token; weight halves every 30 days; network rejects duplicate bond patterns. Attacker cost: 1,000 POA per identity; 500 clones over 90 days needs 500,000 POA plus 90 days of re-staking. Like saffron dye in an ocean, each clone disperses into crystal-clear noise, and the attacker drowns in its own bonds.
